ci_support_linux_64_python3.11.____cpyth:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
name: persistent
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "6.9"

package:
  name: persistent
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/p/persistent/persistent-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 85727c3d638ff8830878abf816acfaa8c288a3b372ab77ba482367eba970e2b2

build:
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools
    - cffi
    - pip
  run:
    - python
    - zope.deferredimport
    - zope.interface
    - cffi

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - persistent
      pip_check: true
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python
        - manuel
    script:
      - python -m unittest discover -b -v persistent

about:
  summary: Translucent persistent objects
  license: ZPL-2.1
  license_file:
    - COPYRIGHT.txt
    - LICENSE.txt
  homepage: https://github.com/zopefoundation/persistent/
  documentation: https://persistent.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - osamples
    - izahn
    - mgorny
